test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

The sweet and bitter memories of her past __make her weak and sad. __

options.text: ought to make her pallid and unhappy
had to make her pale and unhappy
must make her pastel and unhappy

solution:
The correct answer is **'made her feeble and unhappy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of 'past' in the context gives us the idea that the action took place in the past.
 
• 'make' is in the present indefinite tense. Hence, its tense form is incorrect.
 
• So, to improve the sentence, we need to replace the word **make. **
 
• Of the given options, only 'made' (past tense)** **should replace the word 'make'.
 
• The rest of the **options **are grammatically incorrect.
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct replacement for the underlined part. 

**Correct sentence__ - ***The sweet and bitter memories of her past **__made her weak and sad.__***
